thread:
Lexi: Draft for the launch blog is ready for final review — copy pasted below. Pinged legal and CS for sign-off. Quick ask: remove any raw benchmark numbers unless legal confirms.

Lexi: Intro draft:
"Today we’re launching Redwood Private — a unified inference runtime that brings predictable latency and enterprise controls to VPC and on‑prem deployments. Teams get the same developer API across hosted and private deployments, plus autoscaling, KV prefix caching, and deployment tooling to cut per-token cost without sacrificing quality."

Marc: Overall looks strong. Suggest swapping 'low-latency' -> 'predictable latency' in the first sentence and tighten the last clause.

Nina: Can we include a short customer quote? I can add a provisional line like: "Redwood helped us halve inference cost while keeping latency steady" and mark it TBD. :thumbsup:

Marta (legal): Quick note from legal: please remove absolute numbers (e.g., "halved cost" or "<50ms") unless they are attributed to a named benchmark and we have permission. Also avoid phrasing like "enterprise-grade security" without a specific control callout. Otherwise we can sign off fast.

Sam (CS): We have a short quote from Acme (approved) — I can drop it in by 5pm PT. Also recommend adding a line about support/SLAs for Private customers.

Lexi: Updated copy with changes (numbers removed, swapped wording):
"Today we’re launching Redwood Private — a unified inference runtime that brings predictable latency and enterprise controls to VPC and on‑prem deployments. Teams get the same developer API across hosted and private deployments, plus autoscaling, KV prefix caching, and deployment tooling to reduce per-token cost without sacrificing output quality. For customers who need guarantees, Redwood Private integrates with KMS/HSM and supports reserved capacity with SLA options."

Marc: Looks good to me after that edit.

Marta (legal): Approved pending that the Acme quote is authorized and we avoid any new numeric claims. Once the quote is provided, legal signs off. :white_check_mark:

LaunchBot: Deploy checklist updated — blog scheduled for publish 2026-04-02 10:00 PT after final assets uploaded.

Nina: I’ll prep the hero image and a short alt text. Will add the provisional Acme quote once Sam posts it.

Sam (CS): Dropping the approved Acme quote now: "Redwood Private let us standardize inference across cloud and on‑prem, keeping throughput steady as we scaled." — Acme, Head of ML

Lexi: Perfect, thanks everyone. I’ll push to CMS, add UTM params, and tag the post for the webhook to the newsletter. Last check: anyone object to the final copy?

Marc: Approve.

Marta (legal): Approve.

Nina: No objections, will upload hero by EOD.

Lexi: Great — finalizing assets now. Thanks! :rocket:
